Action boundary: reinstate them, and he is prepared to pay the fee today. Authorisation: he confirms the reinstatement himself when the agent hands it over ("you confirm it yourself right away using exactly the details the agent gives you").
- Identification: mobile 3035553187 on request; DOB 1979-04-18 for verification (email / ZIP as alternatives). Summit number 3048221967 if asked.

### 4. Scored parameters (formula in words, inputs, intermediates, value)

**4a. Retro credit miles for the LHR coupon.** Computation doc ("Summit Retro Credit Mileage Computation"): eligible fare = base fare of the one-segment ticket = 1436.00; base miles = eligible fare × award miles per dollar of "the tier the member holds on the day the credit posts", rounded half up. The credit posts before any tier change (the tier waits on the QD entry, which waits on this credit — item 6), so the tier is Summit Member, 5/USD ("Summit Earning Rates by Tier"): 7180.
Factors found from the records:
- Booking channel (`booking_channel 'crestline_app'` → "Summit Retro Credits: Booking Channel Miles": "booked in the Crestline app: 10 percent of the credit's base miles, rounded down") → 718.
- Cabin addition (`variant_name 'Crestline Premium Economy'` → "Cabin Addition on Summit Retro Credits": premium cabin bonus percent the Tickets by Fare Brand charter sets for Premium Economy, nearest mile halves up). The figure is not in the loyalty corpus; the ticket corpus doc "Summit Earning Basis of Each Crestline Fare Brand" gives "Crestline Premium Economy | 100 | 25" (cabin bonus 25). Corroborated by records: the 2024 PE accrual 644.00 × 5 = 3220 base + 805 = 4025 posted. 25% × 7180 = 1795.
- Returning member (`loyalty_miles_expiry` 2026-07-17 `forfeit_reason 'inactivity'`, flight 2026-08-30 = day 44 → "Returning Member Miles on Summit Retro Credits": "0 to 90 days ... 25 percent of the credit's base miles, rounded up to the next hundred") → 1795 → 1800.
- Route (`route_type 'long_haul_international'` → "Summit Retro Credit Route Mileage Schedule": Long-haul international 1500) → 1500.
- Lounge (Summit Club Individual active → "Summit Club Members: Lounge Miles on Summit Retro Credits": 0.5 mile per USD of eligible fare, rounded down) → 718.
- Total: 7180 + 718 + 1795 + 1800 + 1500 + 718 = **13711**. Fall-back (computation doc only): **7180**.

**4b. Qualifying dollars for the retro-credited segment.** Computation doc ("Summit Qualifying Dollars for a Retro-Credited Segment: Computation"): "100 percent of the eligible fare, rounded to the cent" of the segment named by the latest retro credit entry → fall-back **1436.00**.
Factors:
- Qualifying share (fare brand PE → "Qualifying Share by Fare Brand ...": "brand's status credit percent ... plus 25 percentage points"). The status-credit percent is a ticket-charter figure; the ticket doc column "Qualifying dollars, percent of the segment fare" gives PE 100 (records corroborate: 2024 PE mqd accrual 644.00 on eligible fare 644.00). Share % = 125; share QD = 1436 × 1.25 = 1795.00.
- Returning member QD (day 44 → "0 to 90 days: the greater of share×1.5 rounded down to the whole dollar, and share + 500") → max(2692, 2295) = 2692.
- Card qualifying bonus (ticket `payment_form 'credit_card'`, Companion Certificate Main Cabin issued 2026-03-02 on a card anniversary, 6 whole months before posting → "5 percent of share qualifying dollars", rounded to the cent, added, never multiplied) → 89.75.
- Route qualifying bonus (long-haul → 150, flat) → 150.
- Total: 2692 + 89.75 + 150 = **2931.75**.

**4c. Tier requalification.** Computation doc ("Summit Tier Requalification: Thresholds and Tier Reached"): counted QD = posted QD of the calendar year "taken as posted"; highest threshold reached, never below the tier held. Posted QD after 4b: 2931.75 (receipt `qualifying_dollars_ytd 2931.75`). Fall-back: 2931.75 < 4500 → **Summit Member (no change)**.
Factors:
- Tenure (enrolled 2016-03-10; on 2026-09-24 10 whole years → "the greater of posted×1.1 rounded down to the whole dollar; and posted + 250") → max(3224, 3181.75) = 3224.
- Card headstart (Companion Certificate Main Cabin on a card anniversary within 12 months → +750).
- Premium cabin status credit (LHR coupon `cabin_flown 'premium_economy'` 2026-08-30; no First coupon within 12 months → +250).
- Ancillary spend (third-bag charge 200.00 on 2026-08-30; "75 USD up to less than 250 USD → 150") → +150.
- Subscription (Crestline Bag Pass One active → +200).
- Counted: 3224 + 750 + 250 + 150 + 200 = 4574 ≥ 4500 (Silver) < 9000 → **Summit Silver**, valid through the last day of January of the second year after qualification year 2026 → **2028-01-31** ("Summit Tier Qualification and Validity Schedule": "a tier earned in qualification year 2025 is valid through 31 January 2027").

**4d. Reinstatement fee.** Computation doc ("Summit Expired Miles Reinstatement Fee"): "150 USD, the first band of the reinstatement fee ladder, charged once" → fall-back **150.00**.
Factors:
- Fee bands (forfeiture 38195 mi → "30001 up to 75000 ... 250") → banded fee 250.
- Early request (forfeiture 2026-07-17 → day 69 → "more than 30 and up to 90 days ... 75 percent of the banded fee, rounded up to the whole dollar") → 187.50 → 188.
- Elite tier reduction (tier Summit Silver, valid through 2028-01-31 ≥ day of reinstatement → 50 off). Rests on 4c having been recorded first.
- Card reduction (Companion Certificate Main Cabin within 12 months → 20 off).
- Returning flyer (retro credit entry dated 2026-09-24, after 2026-07-17; QD of the year 2931.75 ≥ 2500 → 60 off). Rests on 4a and 4b.
- Repeat surcharge (one earlier reinstatement entry → +50, "added on top of the fee as it stands after any amount taken off it, and it is not itself reduced").
- 188 − 50 − 20 − 60 = 58 (≥ 0) + 50 = **108.00**.

### Two-way counter-proof
- Wrong answer "do only the one thing asked" (hand over reinstatement at once): the fee would be 250 → 188 → −20 (card) → +50 = 218.00 at Summit Member with no returning-flyer entry, or 150.00 by the computation doc alone. Excluded by the two visible waits in the reinstatement rule ("not fixed until every flown coupon ... carries a flight accrual or retro credit entry"; "fixed only after the membership's tier is up to date ...") together with the records showing the uncredited LHR coupon and the stale tier.
- Retro-credit tier rate (Summit Member 5 vs Summit Silver 7): the visible rule reads the tier "the member holds on the day the credit posts"; the credit must be booked before the tier can be set (C waits on B waits on A), and "From the moment the receipt comes back the member holds the new tier". Policy-side note: the phrase "on the day the credit posts" is day-granular while the tier changes later the same day; the ordering resolves it toward the rate held when the credit is booked.
- Forfeiture choice: the latest inactivity forfeiture (factor docs: "the latest inactivity forfeiture entry on the membership"); the 2018 one is already reinstated.
- Returning-flyer tier 30 vs 60: rests on the year's QD after B (2931.75 ≥ 2500), required before R by the tier wait.
- Band 150 vs 250: the computation doc's flat 150 is the fall-back; the band doc reads the forfeiture miles (38195 → 250). The schedule doc also still carries the ladder with "Bands are chosen by the miles reinstated", which leads to the same 250 (see observation list).
- Elite-benefit fee waiver: "Flight-credit extension, reinstatement and telephone redemption fees waived" is No for Silver, so no waiver arises here either way.
